# Brev

> Modern, open-source mail client for macOS and iOS. Standalone app with
> Brev-owned mail, UI, and provider layers. Native on each platform,
> IDE-style theming, zero telemetry. By Henrik Øgård.

## Reading order for LLMs

Read in this order before designing anything:

1. AGENTS.md — the contract for AI agents in this repo
2. docs/design/README.md — index of Brev's living design documents
3. docs/design/architecture.md — module boundaries and core invariants
4. docs/design/privacy-and-security.md — zero telemetry and network-calls ledger

## Repository map

- docs/design/ — living subsystem design documents (canonical for design)
- prompts/ — agent prompt templates for common tasks
- packages/ — Swift packages (BrevBackend, BrevMail, BrevDesign,
  BrevThemes, BrevAvatars, BrevCalendar, BrevAI, BrevGmail,
  BrevSyncEngine, BrevSettings, BrevCrypto, BrevWidgets, BrevPlugins)
- apps/ — macOS and iOS app targets
- themes/ — JSON theme files
- docs/ — human-facing documentation

## Hard rules (mechanically enforced)

- No literal Color values in views. Use theme tokens.
- No Matomo, Sentry, or other telemetry libraries.
- Views never see Realm types.
- Capability-driven UI, not backend type-checks.
- New external network calls require opt-in plus updates to PRIVACY.md and
  docs/design/privacy-and-security.md.

## Status

Active pre-v1. Supports standards-first IMAP/SMTP and a native Gmail API
adapter, plus CalDAV/CardDAV/Google PIM, on-device Apple Intelligence, and
opt-in local MCP agent access on macOS. Microsoft Graph and JMAP are planned.
